title: Administrator
description:
Administrator

Doncaster

Up to £27,000 per annum

Full Time, Permanent

We are currently recruiting for an Administrator to join a well-established and friendly law firm based in Doncaster. This is an excellent opportunity for an organised and professional individual looking to build a long-term career within a supportive office environment.

Previous invoicing experience would be advantageous but is not essential, as full training can be provided.

Key Responsibilities:
- Providing administrative support to solicitors and the wider team
- Managing incoming calls, emails and correspondence
- Preparing, formatting and proofreading legal documents and letters
- Maintaining accurate client records and filing systems
- Scheduling appointments and managing diaries
- Processing and distributing post
- Assisting with invoicing and billing administration
- Updating internal databases and case management systems
- Handling confidential information with discretion and professionalism
- Supporting general office administration duties as required

The Ideal Candidate:
- Previous office administration experience
- Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail
- Confident communication skills, both written and verbal
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office packages
- Ability to prioritise workloads and work to deadlines
- Professional and personable approach
- Previous invoicing or finance administration experience is desirable but not essential

Benefits:
- Competitive salary of up to £27,000
- Full training provided
- Friendly and supportive working environment
- Opportunity to develop within a reputable law firm
- Stable, full-time permanent position

If you are a motivated and organised administrator looking for your next opportunity in Doncaster, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Call Centre Agent
description:
Sales Advisors

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our Doncaster team's full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our Doncaster contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths
- Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.
- It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.
- People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE

GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 which goes up to £26,738 after 8 months.

UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.

BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, free parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.

GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.

FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.

GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

title: HR Assistant
description:
Elevation HR are delighted to be recruiting for an experienced HR Administrator / HR Assistant on behalf of a well-established organisation based in Doncaster on a full-time, permanent basis.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with HR administration experience who enjoys working in a fast-paced, process-driven environment and is looking to develop their HR career within a busy, supportive team.

The business is currently undergoing an exciting HR transformation, including the implementation of new systems and processes, making this a fantastic time to join. Working within a centralised HR function, you'll support the wider HR team and HR Business Partners with a broad range of employee lifecycle administration, recruitment coordination, absence management and HR systems administration.

As a HR Assistant you will be:
- Supporting recruitment activity including interview coordination, issuing offers and contracts, onboarding administration and pre-employment checks
- Managing and maintaining HR systems
- Supporting absence management processes, maintaining records, monitoring documentation and producing reports
- Administering employee lifecycle activities including starters, leavers, probation reviews and contractual changes
- Preparing HR correspondence
- Liaising with payroll regarding starters, leavers and employee changes
- Maintaining organisational charts, HR trackers and reporting data
- Supporting the administration of employee benefits
- Producing HR reports and analysing data using Excel
- Acting as a key point of contact for HR-related queries

Benefits as a HR Assistant include:
- Hybrid Working - 2 Days Working from home following probation
- Early Friday Finish
- 25 Days Annual Leave plus bank holidays
- Additional days leave for birthday

What we're looking for from a HR Assistant:
- Previous experience within a HR Administrator, Assistant or Coordination role
- Strong understanding of core HR processes including recruitment administration, absence management and employee lifecycle activities
- Confidence managing high volumes of administration with excellent attention to detail
- Comfortable working across multiple HR systems and databases
- Strong communication skills with the confidence to pick up the phone and build relationships across the business
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel
- CIPD Level 3 qualification (or working towards) is desirable

We're keen to speak with driven, organised and detail-focused HR professionals who enjoy being part of a busy team and take pride in delivering a first-class HR service. For more details, get in touch with Demi Fearn.

title: HR Coordinator
description:
HR Coordinator

Doncaster
Salary: Up to £35,000 per annum
Hours: Monday to Thursday 8:30am - 5:00pm Friday 8:30am - 4:30pm
Full Time Permanent

Our client, a well-established and growing business based in Doncaster, is currently looking to recruit an experienced HR Coordinator to join their team on a full-time, permanent basis.

This is a fantastic opportunity for a proactive HR professional looking for a varied and rewarding role within a supportive and busy environment. You'll play a key role in supporting the day-to-day HR function and ensuring all HR processes run smoothly across the business.

The Role

As HR Coordinator, your responsibilities will include:

Coordinating and maintaining the HR system, ensuring employee records are accurate and up to date

Preparing and administering payroll hours for submission to a third-party payroll provider

Providing support and administration throughout grievance and disciplinary processes

Managing recruitment administration, including posting job adverts, shortlisting candidates, arranging interviews and liaising with applicants

Conducting pre-employment checks and supporting the onboarding process

Producing HR documentation, reports and employee correspondence

Providing general administrative support to the HR department

About You

To be considered for this role, you will have:

Previous experience within a HR Coordinator, HR Administrator, HR Assistant or similar HR position

CIPD Level 3 qualification

Excellent organisational and administrative skills

Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities

A professional and confidential approach when handling sensitive information

Strong communication skills and a proactive, positive attitude

What's on Offer?

Salary up to £35,000 per annum

Full-time, permanent position

Opportunity to work within a supportive and growing business

Varied role with exposure to all aspects of HR

If you're an experienced HR professional looking for your next opportunity in Doncaster, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today for consideration.
